explanation: Their establishment depends on authoritative revealed communication; rational arguments still establish that communication’s authority.
Being sent from God to creation; the text reports several etymologies and distinctions from messengership.
The text reports both a shared definition with prophet and narrower definitions; it does not impose one definition throughout.
The act or status of being sent with a mission, not resurrection in this passage.
Beneficial divine aid; whether it must be provided is the point in dispute.
A normative obligation attributed to an agent.
A necessary effect’s proceeding from its principle, not a debt imposed upon it.
Imposing duties on a responsible agent; the text also speaks of the period in which those duties apply.
An enduring readiness or capacity, distinguished from a single act.
An extraordinary event linked to a prophetic claim and challenge, not just anything marvellous.
The text distinguishes a positive contrary of power from the simple absence of power.
The link between a prophetic claim and the sign presented to establish it.
Producing a matching act in response to the challenge; not merely disagreement.
A preparatory extraordinary sign before the prophetic mission.
An extraordinary favour not accompanied by a prophetic claim.
The established regularity distinguished from intrinsic rational possibility.
In the epistemic passages it describes non-inferential knowledge; it must not be confused with normative obligation.
Transmission through a plurality treated as producing certain knowledge, not simply a famous report.
Here it often denotes authenticating a claimant; elsewhere its logical and theological senses require separate attention.
What follows an action or what it is ordered towards; distinct here from the agent’s motivating purpose.
An intended end or motive; not ʿaraḍ, an accident.
An act such as appointing someone, contrasted with reporting an already established fact.
Requiring cooperative civil association for human life, as explicated by the text.
In the philosophical account, preparedness to receive knowledge, not spatial contact.
A receptive condition; each form requires its own corresponding preparedness.
The underlying matter of the elements in the philosophical theory being presented.
The bodily mixture or constitution invoked by the historical physiology, not personality alone.
An internal perceptual faculty, not everyday sound judgement.
The faculty to which formed figures and ordered speech are represented in the philosophical account.
Distinguished from the imaginative faculty in the local faculty analysis.
A higher principle especially related to the elemental world in this account.
The antecedent knowledge of fitting order invoked to explain ordered procession.
The demonstrative incapacity to meet the challenge, whose ground is disputed here.
The rhetorical contrast is between answering the literary challenge and armed confrontation.
Distinguishes linguistic excellence from appropriateness and effectiveness of the composition in its situation.
An external prevention of imitation, analysed by power, motives, and requisite cognitions.
May concern outward ordering or the coordinated relations of meanings and significations.
Not simply unusual form or rhyme.
Description of a whole according to a predominant component; one proposed answer to lexical objections.
Not the English word law; its linguistic and inferential functions are distinguished.
Terms used in the entailment discussion; logical direction must be preserved.
The fifteen named metres are part of an opponent’s argument, not an editor-verified scansion.
Classifies signs before the public claim and those confirming it.
The contextual birth sense is supported by Lisān al-ʿArab, سرر; it does not mean happy here.
The deficiency alleged by an opponent when arguing against abrogation.
In the author’s final refinement, disclosure of the end of a previously unrestrictedly stated ruling.
The indispensable distinction determining the scope of perpetuity.
The two classes addressed by the mission in this argument.
The graded evidence in the Ascension conclusion is not reduced to one level.
The metaphysical premise of one argument that the heavens can be traversed.
A divinely grounded protection discussed here through specific classes of fault rather than as an undifferentiated absolute.
A legally minor act whose baseness or social effect would repel people from following a prophet.
A standard interpretive category used to preserve real divine correction without classifying the act as grave disobedience.

rendering: approaching the point of doing something
explanation: Used in one reading of Joseph’s hamm: he neared an intention but did not form the culpable resolve itself.
